visual_action: A slideshow of two still photos of Dr. Annie Andrews. In both, she is wearing a white doctor's coat with a stethoscope around her neck and is standing in a medical office hallway. In the first photo, she is looking slightly off-camera. In the second, she is smiling directly at the camera.

cast.name: Annie Andrews
cast.evidence: Her name appears in large on-screen text: 'DR. ANNIE ANDREWS WINS SOUTH CAROLINA DEMOCRATIC PRIMARY FOR U.S. SENATE'. Her photo is the only visual content.

cast.name: Democratic Party
